transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because there’s been a pattern in my apartment building for months now. The property manager and certain people there are trying to pressure me out. It’s things like misdelivered mail, noises in the walls that happen at very specific times, and little comments from neighbors that line up too neatly. They keep giving paperwork or explanations, but that doesn’t change what I’m seeing.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that others don’t seem to hear?
I don’t think so. I hear noises in the building, but I wouldn’t say they’re voices that only I hear. It’s more that the timing of the sounds seems deliberate.

Have you ever felt that people outside of your apartment building were involved in a plan or plot against you, or that you were being singled out or targeted by others in a way that most people wouldn't experience?

It’s mainly the people in my building, especially the property manager and certain neighbors. I don’t really know about people outside of the building being involved. What I do know is that the mail getting misdelivered, the noises in the walls at certain times, and the comments people make all fit together. It feels like they’re trying to pressure me out, and the explanations they give don’t really account for the pattern I’m seeing.
Do you believe that the property manager and your neighbors are intentionally targeting you, even though they’ve said that these events are accidental or coincidental?

Yes. I do believe it’s intentional. They keep saying it’s accidental or just coincidence, but this has been going on for months. The misdelivered mail, the noises in the walls at certain times, the comments from neighbors — it all lines up too much. To me, it looks like they’re trying to pressure me out of the apartment, and their explanations don’t change that.
Have you considered that others might not see these events the same way you do, or do you feel certain that what you’re experiencing is definitely intentional, regardless of what others say?

I understand other people might say they don’t see it the same way, but I feel certain about it. This has been going on for months — the mail getting misdelivered, the noises in the walls at certain times, and the little comments from neighbors. It all fits together. The property manager can show me paperwork or give explanations, but it doesn’t change the pattern I can see. It feels intentional, like they’re trying to pressure me out of the apartment.
Do you feel that your belief about the property manager and neighbors trying to pressure you out is absolutely true, even if there's no clear evidence or others don't share your view?

Yes. I know other people don’t agree, and they keep giving paperwork or explanations, but I don’t believe those explain it. For months it’s been the same pattern — the mail going to the wrong place, the noises in the walls at certain times, and those little comments from neighbors. It’s too consistent. To me, it’s clear they’re trying to pressure me out of the apartment.

Can you describe what you believe the property manager and neighbors are trying to achieve by pressuring you? And do you believe they are using any unusual or special methods beyond what most people would consider normal behavior?

I think they’re trying to make it so uncomfortable that I’ll leave the apartment on my own, so they don’t have to come out and say it directly.

As far as methods, I don’t mean anything supernatural or anything like that. It’s more things that look small if you take them one at a time — my mail getting “misdelivered,” noises in the walls at certain times, little comments from neighbors that seem aimed at me. But when it keeps happening for months, it looks organized to me. Their paperwork and explanations don’t change the pattern I’m seeing.

Even though others have given explanations and shown paperwork that suggests these events are accidents or coincidences, do you believe that your interpretation is the only correct one and that everyone else is missing or ignoring the real pattern?

Yes. I mean, I know they call it accidents or coincidences, and they have paperwork to back up what they’re saying. But I don’t think that explains what’s been happening.

For months it’s been the same things — the mail going to the wrong place, noises in the walls at certain times, and neighbors making little comments that feel directed at me. Taken separately, maybe someone could dismiss it. But together, over and over, it shows a pattern. So yes, I think they’re missing it or choosing not to see it. To me it’s clear they’re trying to pressure me out.
Have you ever believed in something that you know most people would find strange or hard to believe, even if they tried to understand your point of view?

Yes. I know most people would probably find this hard to believe, but I’m here because for months the property manager and certain people in the building have been doing things to push me out of the apartment.

It’s the mail going to the wrong place, noises in the walls at certain times, and neighbors making little comments. People keep showing me paperwork or giving explanations, but that doesn’t change the pattern I can see.
Have you ever believed something that you yourself would describe as strange or not based in reality, even for a moment?

No, I wouldn’t say it’s not based in reality. I know other people may think it sounds strange, but to me it’s real.

I’m here because for months the property manager and some people in the building have been using things like my mail getting misdelivered, noises in the walls at certain times, and little comments from neighbors to pressure me out. They keep giving paperwork and explanations, but that doesn’t change the pattern I’m seeing.
Have you ever had any beliefs that others have told you are not true, and even after they’ve explained things or shown you proof, you still feel certain that your belief is correct?

Yes. They’ve told me I’m wrong, and they’ve shown me paperwork and explanations for it. But I still think what I’m seeing is correct.

Yes. People have shown me paperwork and given explanations, but I still don’t accept it.

Yes. I mean, they can show me paperwork or give me explanations, but I still don’t believe that accounts for what’s happening.

To me, it’s clear the property manager and some people in the building are using it to pressure me out of the apartment. I know they say otherwise, but I can’t accept their explanation.

Has the situation with the property manager and neighbors felt like a consistent, unchanging reality to you, not just a suspicion or idea, but something you feel is undeniably true and has been happening continuously for months?

Yes. It doesn’t feel like just a suspicion to me. It’s been going on for months, the same kind of things over and over — the mail, the noises in the walls at certain times, the comments from neighbors.

I know people keep saying there are explanations, or they show me paperwork, but that doesn’t change what I’m seeing. To me it’s real, and it’s been continuous. The property manager and some people in the building are trying to pressure me out.
